title: UI Health Care Stead Family Children’s Hospital again ranked No. 1 in Iowa
summary_en: Stead Family Children’s Hospital is again Iowa’s top children’s hospital, and seven specialties are ranked among the nation's best in the 2026–27 “Best Children’s Hospitals” rankings published by U.S. News & World Report.

title: AI innovations, expanded health care access among quarterly strategic plan updates
summary_en: Check out the latest Plan in Progress. From preparing students, faculty, and staff for an AI-enabled future to expanding health care across the state and investing in academic spaces, the quarterly update highlights the many ways our campus community is building for what’s next.

title: Advanced computing methods developed at UI could help improve drug development
summary_en: Researchers in the College of Engineering and College of Pharmacy are developing advanced computing tools to predict how drug ingredients behave during manufacturing. By identifying potential problems earlier, the approach could make drug development faster and less expensive while helping ensure medications are effective when they reach patients.
title_cn: Advanced computing methods developed at UI could help improve drug development

title: UI celebrates Constitution Day, commemorating the signing of the U.S. constitution
summary_en: Constitution Day, also known as Citizenship Day, will be celebrated Sept. 17, commemorating this date in 1787 when delegates to the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia signed the United States Constitution. UI Libraries has created a helpful guide for how to incorporate Constitution Day materials in the classroom. Libraries also will be handing out free pocket Constitutions on a first-come,
